description: Reusable .NET 10 package that wraps ASP.NET Core Identity with cookie and JWT auth, Google OAuth, a pluggable e-mail provider, a multi-tenant model with dynamic RBAC (roles + module permissions), and secure defaults — wired up with a single AddMyIdentity call. JWT and Google OAuth secrets are supplied by the consumer (never shipped in the package).
releaseNotes: v5.2.0: platform permissions, additive. An account without a tenant can hold permissions on platform modules, which an application declares apart from its tenant modules (MyIdentityPermissionOptions.AddPlatformModule or MyIdentity:PlatformPermissions:Modules); only a SystemAdmin writes the grants. Not using them needs no migration and no code change: ApplyMyIdentityPlatformPermissionsModel() is called by none of the library's own model methods, and MyIdentity:PlatformPermissions:Enabled is false by default. To use them, call it in OnModelCreating, add one migration and set Enabled. Adds MyIdentityPlatformGrant, MyIdentityPlatformPermissionsOptions (MyIdentityOptions.PlatformPermissions), IMyIdentityPlatformPermissionService (HasPlatformPermissionAsync), IMyIdentityPlatformPermissionAdminService, the attribute MyIdentityRequirePlatformPermission with its requirement and handler, the policy-name helper MyIdentityPolicies.PlatformPermission, and four describer messages (a describer of your own sees them in English until you override them). Behaviour change (security), only for a code declared as a platform module and with Enabled on or off: a tenant question (IMyIdentityPermissionService) about it is denied to everyone but a SystemAdmin, with a Warning, so a page protected with MyIdentityRequirePermission by mistake no longer admits every TenantAdmin; protect a platform page with MyIdentityRequirePlatformPermission. A singleton permission core with scope validation on throws when asked about a platform code. New startup validation of the platform catalog and of the raw MyIdentity:PlatformPermissions section, even with the feature off. With UseTenantOnLogin on, an account without a tenant that holds a platform grant signs in when the login names no tenant; revoking its last grant rotates its security stamp. Every path that removes an account's role assignments (assigning a tenant, removing it from its tenant, soft or hard delete) also removes its grants. Passkeys: the limits are public (MyIdentityPasskeyLimits.MaxPasskeysPerUser and MaxNameLength, static read-only properties), and MyIdentityPasskeySignInDTO.CredentialJson is string? with no initializer, so a new DTO carries null and, under [ApiController], a form whose field is present and empty reaches the service (InvalidCredentials) instead of the framework's 400. MyIdentityLoginDTO and MyIdentitySignInCodeDTO gain RememberMe, default true so the cookie stays persistent unless a caller sets false (the passkey DTO's default stays false). IMyIdentityPasskeyService gains GetPasskeyRegistrationStatusAsync, the status BeginPasskeyRegistrationAsync would answer, without beginning the ceremony: incompatible for a class that implements the interface. The package validation baseline is 5.1.1. Upgrading from 5.1.1: MyIdentity/UPGRADE.md §46.
title: Kerberos.MyIdentity
